tabs.html:
Micron 8GB 2400 MHz ECC REG Server RAM – Reliable and High-Performance Memory for Servers

Enhance the performance and reliability of your server infrastructure with the Micron 8GB 2400 MHz ECC REG Server RAM. Designed for mission-critical applications, this ECC (Error-Correcting Code) memory module offers superior data integrity, reducing the risk of data corruption and system crashes. Ideal for data centers, enterprise applications, and virtualized environments, this 2400 MHz memory delivers fast, consistent performance to meet the demanding needs of modern servers.

The Micron 8GB ECC REG RAM is built with Registered DIMM (RDIMM) architecture, ensuring stability and scalability in multi-processor server setups. It supports high-density configurations for large-scale deployments, making it the perfect choice for enterprises looking to maximize system uptime and performance.


Key Features:

  • 8GB capacity for improved multitasking and data processing
  • 2400 MHz speed for fast and efficient data handling
  • ECC (Error-Correcting Code) for enhanced data integrity and reduced system errors
  • Registered DIMM (RDIMM) for multi-processor server compatibility and scalability
  • Ideal for enterprise servers, virtualization, and data center environments
  • Compatible with major server brands such as Dell, HP, and Lenovo


Built to handle demanding applications such as databases, cloud computing, and high-performance computing (HPC)
